title: Trade-In Back-Haul Credit on the Vehicle Purchase Agreements Transfer Shipping Fee
content:
**Clause.** Under Vehicle Purchase Agreements, a trade-in collected by the delivery truck earns a back-haul credit against the transfer shipping fee. The credit turns on two records: whether an accepted agreement in Trade-In Agreements is linked to the order, and the fulfillment method of the order's handover appointment in Delivery & Pickup Appointments.

| Accepted trade-in agreement linked to the order | Handover appointment | Back-haul credit |
|---|---|---|
| yes | Kestrel Local Home Delivery or Kestrel Extended-Zone Delivery | $125.00 (the home back-haul credit) |
| yes | Kestrel Hub Pickup or Kestrel Vending Tower Pickup | $40.00 (the hub back-haul credit) |
| yes | Kestrel Fly & Drive, Kestrel Enclosed White-Glove Delivery, or no appointment | none |
| no | any | none |

The credit is subtracted from the transfer shipping fee once the carrier price has been reduced by the program's shipping fee discount and rounded, together with anything else added to or subtracted from that discounted fee, and the result is never below zero.

**Hypothetical cases.**
- Accepted trade-in linked, Kestrel Extended-Zone Delivery, discounted transfer price $799.00: $674.00.
- Accepted trade-in linked, Kestrel Vending Tower Pickup, discounted price $499.00: $459.00.
- A trade-in offer that was never accepted, Kestrel Local Home Delivery: no credit.
